item.title: [Lanka Talks] Chinese Dragon Café opens flagship outlet in Negombo
item.description: Chinese Dragon Café has opened its newest outlet in Negombo at No. 48 Chilaw Road, marking its 13th outlet in Sri Lanka and 14th worldwide. Founded in 1942 in Bambalapitiya, the brand continues expansion to Negombo with dine-in, private dining, delivery and catering, with further outlets planned in Kandy and Kurunegala.

item.title: [Lanka Talks] People’s Bank and Lanka Securities Join Forces to Launch Sri Lanka’s First Integrated Banking and Share Trading Platform

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] High Grown tea output sinks to 34-year low in September
item.description: Sri Lanka’s tea production fell by nearly 9% year-on-year in September to 20.2 MnKg, from 22.1 MnKg a year earlier, as excessive rainfall and poor growing conditions dragged High Grown output down to its lowest level in 34 years, Asia Siyaka Commodities PLC said, citing preliminary data from the Sri Lanka Tea Board.
